options.text: Eestikeelne tähendus: If a support method agreed with the client stops working, the reason must be clarified before concluding that the client’s motivation has weakened.
Eestikeelne tähendus: If the client wants to share their concern only in writing, the worker must offer that possibility if it supports the client’s expression.
Eestikeelne tähendus: When a new practice is assessed with the client, it is also necessary to ask whether the practice felt like their own or imposed from outside.
